claim_text: The frozen PBC-wide screen contained 6,923 locus–gene–cell comparisons; 5,460 met the ABF overlap threshold.
limitation: Multi-signal inference was restricted to a high-information subset.

claim_text: The source-matched multi-signal workload comprised a prespecified 642-comparison high-information subset.
limitation: Subset was selected from ABF high-information states before multi-signal results.

claim_text: After exact support and disease-statistic matching, multi-signal analysis still showed bidirectional H4/H3 reclassification.
limitation: Real data contain no causal truth; A2-to-M contrasts full inference procedures.

claim_text: Among 113 matched-input ABF H4 comparisons, 79 retained H4 and 8 changed to H3 under the multi-signal model.
limitation: Model-sensitive and uninformative outcomes are separate from H3.

claim_text: Among 452 matched-input ABF H3 comparisons, 413 retained H3 and 10 changed to H4 under the multi-signal model.
limitation: H3-pair support can coexist with other shared pairs.

claim_text: PF50 matched 491 of the 520 comparisons with a definite PF10 H4/H3 state.
limitation: 122 model-sensitive/uninformative PF10 outcomes were not comparable.

claim_text: All 92 stable-H4 comparisons and all 428 stable-H3 comparisons retained the same signal-pair identity across L10 and at least one other PF10 L setting.
limitation: Identity is based on exact leads or two-trait CS Jaccard ≥0.50.

claim_text: Thirty-two stable-H4 comparisons also contained an H3-qualifying pair.
prohibited_verbs: the locus had only one shared signal
limitation: Shared and distinct pairs can coexist within a comparison.

claim_text: Corrected kriging diagnostics were evaluated for every disease and QTL comparison–model unit.
prohibited_verbs: historical runner already evaluated all diagnostics
limitation: This is a post-result diagnostic repair with preserved classifications.

claim_text: One unique official-rule kriging event was reviewed and did not enter any credible set.
limitation: The affected stable-H3 comparison is not claim-bearing.

claim_text: In the frozen distinct-signal scenarios, matched multi-signal inference reduced average false-H4 decisions relative to ABF.
limitation: The unconditional rate includes credible-set discovery failure; pair-conditional results are reported separately.

claim_text: The reduction in false-H4 decisions was accompanied by lower shared-signal recovery.
limitation: Many complex shared simulations lacked an evaluable signal pair; this is not a software error.

claim_text: Performance gains were scenario-dependent: matched false H4 remained 16.0% in S2 and fell from 4.32% to 1.12% in S5.
limitation: High-LD correlated distinct variants remained difficult.

claim_text: The simulation did not establish general method superiority or general safety of LD mismatch.
limitation: The mismatch branch lacks per-trait CS counts for its zero-pair fits and receives no mechanistic no-CS attribution.
